verdict.rationale: Datadog supports OpenTelemetry ingestion and publishes a general API Reference, which could in principle allow programmatic data retrieval, but there is no documented bulk-export feature, data-portability guarantee, or open-format export tool described anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, bulk export tooling, confirmation that exported data covers all product data (logs, metrics, traces) in open formats.
